name: domain-pulse-monorepo
description: Real-time domain health & security audit HUD in Chrome Side Panel. Inspect DNS, SSL/TLS, SPF, DMARC, subdomains, and web tech stack.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @domain-pulse/shared build && pnpm --filter @domain-pulse/server build && pnpm --filter @domain-pulse/extension build
scripts.build:safari: pnpm build:extension && DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app xcrun safari-web-extension-converter apps/extension/dist --project-location apps/safari --app-name DomainPulse --bundle-identifier im.carlosrivera.DomainPulse --macos-only --no-open --force && DEVELOPER_DIR=/Applications/Xcode.app xcodebuild -project apps/safari/DomainPulse/DomainPulse.xcodeproj -scheme DomainPulse -configuration Debug build CODE_SIGN_IDENTITY="" CODE_SIGNING_REQUIRED=NO CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO && codesign -f -s - --deep /Users/carlos/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData/DomainPulse-*/Build/Products/Debug/DomainPulse.app && /System/Library/Frameworks/CoreServices.framework/Frameworks/LaunchServices.framework/Support/lsregister -f -R -trusted /Users/carlos/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData/DomainPulse-*/Build/Products/Debug/DomainPulse.app
